responsibility: This file implements IR-independent target capability queries for the optabs subsystem. It answers whether specific conversion, extraction, vector, atomic, compare-and-swap, gather/scatter, length-based load/store, and shift-related operations are directly supported for given machine modes, interpreting insn patterns, target hooks, and per-target optab tables and caching some results so that higher-level expanders can choose between inline patterns and fallbacks without depending on a particular IR.
same_name_distinction: Implements the optabs-query stem’s IR-agnostic target-support checks declared in gcc/optabs-query.h, including mode/icode lookup wrappers, bitfield extraction-pattern discovery, and cached support probes for gathers, scatters, atomics, and length-based vector load/store. Unlike the header, this file contains the executable query logic and target-state storage.
